import { Icon } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/icon";

import { Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarImage } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/avatar";
import { Button } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/button";
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuGroup,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
  DropdownMenuList,
} from "@/registry/erbium/ui/dropdown-menu";

export const DropdownMenuAvatar = () => (
  <DropdownMenu>
    <DropdownMenuTrigger
      render={<Button variant="ghost" size="icon-lg" className="rounded-avatar" />}
    >
      <Avatar>
        <AvatarImage
          src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2264%22%20height%3D%2264%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2064%2064%22%3E%3Crect%20width%3D%2264%22%20height%3D%2264%22%20rx%3D%2232%22%20fill%3D%22%23475569%22%2F%3E%3Ctext%20x%3D%2232%22%20y%3D%2233%22%20text-anchor%3D%22middle%22%20dominant-baseline%3D%22middle%22%20font-family%3D%22sans-serif%22%20font-size%3D%2222%22%20fill%3D%22white%22%3EJD%3C%2Ftext%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E"
          alt="John Doe"
        />
        <AvatarFallback>JD</AvatarFallback>
      </Avatar>
    </DropdownMenuTrigger>
    <DropdownMenuContent align="end">
      <DropdownMenuList>
        <DropdownMenuGroup>
          <DropdownMenuItem>
            <Icon name="badge-check" />
            Account
          </DropdownMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenuItem>
            <Icon name="credit-card" />
            Billing
          </DropdownMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenuItem>
            <Icon name="bell" />
            Notifications
          </DropdownMenuItem>
        </DropdownMenuGroup>
        <DropdownMenuSeparator />
        <DropdownMenuItem>
          <Icon name="log-out" />
          Sign Out
        </DropdownMenuItem>
      </DropdownMenuList>
    </DropdownMenuContent>
  </DropdownMenu>
);

import { Button } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/button";
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuGroup,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuLabel,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
  DropdownMenuList,
} from "@/registry/erbium/ui/dropdown-menu";

export const DropdownMenuBasic = () => (
  <DropdownMenu>
    <DropdownMenuTrigger render={<Button variant="outline" />}>Open</DropdownMenuTrigger>
    <DropdownMenuContent>
      <DropdownMenuList>
        <DropdownMenuGroup>
          <DropdownMenuLabel>My Account</DropdownMenuLabel>
          <DropdownMenuItem>Profile</DropdownMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenuItem>Billing</DropdownMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenuItem>Settings</DropdownMenuItem>
        </DropdownMenuGroup>
        <DropdownMenuSeparator />
        <DropdownMenuItem>GitHub</DropdownMenuItem>
        <DropdownMenuItem>Support</DropdownMenuItem>
        <DropdownMenuItem disabled>API</DropdownMenuItem>
      </DropdownMenuList>
    </DropdownMenuContent>
  </DropdownMenu>
);

import * as React from "react";
import { Icon } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/icon";

import { Button } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/button";
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuCheckboxItem,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuGroup,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuLabel,
  DropdownMenuPortal,
  DropdownMenuRadioGroup,
  DropdownMenuRadioItem,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuShortcut,
  DropdownMenuSub,
  DropdownMenuSubContent,
  DropdownMenuSubTrigger,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
  DropdownMenuList,
} from "@/registry/erbium/ui/dropdown-menu";

export const DropdownMenuComplex = () => {
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = React.useState({
    email: true,
    push: true,
    sms: false,
  });

  const [theme, setTheme] = React.useState("light");

  return (
    <DropdownMenu>
      <DropdownMenuTrigger render={<Button variant="outline" />}>Complex Menu</DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <DropdownMenuContent className="w-44">
        <DropdownMenuList>
          <DropdownMenuGroup>
            <DropdownMenuLabel>File</DropdownMenuLabel>
            <DropdownMenuItem>
              <Icon name="file-01" />
              New File
              <DropdownMenuShortcut hotkey="Mod+N" />
            </DropdownMenuItem>
            <DropdownMenuItem>
              <Icon name="folder-01" />
              New Folder
              <DropdownMenuShortcut hotkey="Shift+Mod+N" />
            </DropdownMenuItem>
            <DropdownMenuSub>
              <DropdownMenuSubTrigger>
                <Icon name="folder-open" />
                Open Recent
              </DropdownMenuSubTrigger>
              <DropdownMenuPortal>
                <DropdownMenuSubContent>
                  <DropdownMenuList>
                    <DropdownMenuGroup>
                      <DropdownMenuLabel>Recent Projects</DropdownMenuLabel>
                      <DropdownMenuItem>
                        <Icon name="file-code" />
                        Project Alpha
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                      <DropdownMenuItem>
                        <Icon name="file-code" />
                        Project Beta
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                      <DropdownMenuSub>
                        <DropdownMenuSubTrigger>
                          <Icon name="more-horizontal" />
                          More Projects
                        </DropdownMenuSubTrigger>
                        <DropdownMenuPortal>
                          <DropdownMenuSubContent>
                            <DropdownMenuList>
                              <DropdownMenuItem>
                                <Icon name="file-code" />
                                Project Gamma
                              </DropdownMenuItem>
                              <DropdownMenuItem>
                                <Icon name="file-code" />
                                Project Delta
                              </DropdownMenuItem>
                            </DropdownMenuList>
                          </DropdownMenuSubContent>
                        </DropdownMenuPortal>
                      </DropdownMenuSub>
                    </DropdownMenuGroup>
                    <DropdownMenuSeparator />
                    <DropdownMenuGroup>
                      <DropdownMenuItem>
                        <Icon name="folder-search" />
                        Browse...
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                    </DropdownMenuGroup>
                  </DropdownMenuList>
                </DropdownMenuSubContent>
              </DropdownMenuPortal>
            </DropdownMenuSub>
            <DropdownMenuSeparator />
            <DropdownMenuItem>
              <Icon name="save" />
              Save
              <DropdownMenuShortcut hotkey="Mod+S" />
            </DropdownMenuItem>
            <DropdownMenuItem>
              <Icon name="download-01" />
              Export
              <DropdownMenuShortcut hotkey="Shift+Mod+E" />
            </DropdownMenuItem>
          </DropdownMenuGroup>
          <DropdownMenuSeparator />
          <DropdownMenuGroup>
            <DropdownMenuLabel>View</DropdownMenuLabel>
            <DropdownMenuCheckboxItem
              checked={notifications.email}
              onCheckedChange={(checked) => {
                setNotifications({ ...notifications, email: checked });
              }}
            >
              <Icon name="eye" />
              Show Sidebar
            </DropdownMenuCheckboxItem>
            <DropdownMenuCheckboxItem
              checked={notifications.sms}
              onCheckedChange={(checked) => {
                setNotifications({ ...notifications, sms: checked });
              }}
            >
              <Icon name="layout-01" />
              Show Status Bar
            </DropdownMenuCheckboxItem>
          </DropdownMenuGroup>
          <DropdownMenuSeparator />
          <DropdownMenuGroup>
            <DropdownMenuLabel>Theme</DropdownMenuLabel>
            <DropdownMenuRadioGroup value={theme} onValueChange={setTheme}>
              <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="light">
                <Icon name="sun-03" />
                Light
              </DropdownMenuRadioItem>
              <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="dark">
                <Icon name="moon-02" />
                Dark
              </DropdownMenuRadioItem>
            </DropdownMenuRadioGroup>
          </DropdownMenuGroup>
          <DropdownMenuSeparator />
          <DropdownMenuGroup>
            <DropdownMenuLabel>Account</DropdownMenuLabel>
            <DropdownMenuItem>
              <Icon name="user" />
              Profile
              <DropdownMenuShortcut hotkey="Shift+Mod+P" />
            </DropdownMenuItem>
            <DropdownMenuItem>
              <Icon name="credit-card" />
              Billing
            </DropdownMenuItem>
            <DropdownMenuSub>
              <DropdownMenuSubTrigger>
                <Icon name="settings-01" />
                Settings
              </DropdownMenuSubTrigger>
              <DropdownMenuPortal>
                <DropdownMenuSubContent>
                  <DropdownMenuList>
                    <DropdownMenuGroup>
                      <DropdownMenuLabel>Preferences</DropdownMenuLabel>
                      <DropdownMenuItem>
                        <Icon name="keyboard" />
                        Keyboard Shortcuts
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                      <DropdownMenuItem>
                        <Icon name="languages" />
                        Language
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                      <DropdownMenuSub>
                        <DropdownMenuSubTrigger>
                          <Icon name="bell" />
                          Notifications
                        </DropdownMenuSubTrigger>
                        <DropdownMenuPortal>
                          <DropdownMenuSubContent>
                            <DropdownMenuList>
                              <DropdownMenuGroup>
                                <DropdownMenuLabel>Notification Types</DropdownMenuLabel>
                                <DropdownMenuCheckboxItem
                                  checked={notifications.push}
                                  onCheckedChange={(checked) => {
                                    setNotifications({
                                      ...notifications,
                                      push: checked,
                                    });
                                  }}
                                >
                                  <Icon name="bell" />
                                  Push Notifications
                                </DropdownMenuCheckboxItem>
                                <DropdownMenuCheckboxItem
                                  checked={notifications.email}
                                  onCheckedChange={(checked) => {
                                    setNotifications({
                                      ...notifications,
                                      email: checked,
                                    });
                                  }}
                                >
                                  <Icon name="mail-01" />
                                  Email Notifications
                                </DropdownMenuCheckboxItem>
                              </DropdownMenuGroup>
                            </DropdownMenuList>
                          </DropdownMenuSubContent>
                        </DropdownMenuPortal>
                      </DropdownMenuSub>
                    </DropdownMenuGroup>
                    <DropdownMenuSeparator />
                    <DropdownMenuGroup>
                      <DropdownMenuItem>
                        <Icon name="shield-01" />
                        Privacy & Security
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                    </DropdownMenuGroup>
                  </DropdownMenuList>
                </DropdownMenuSubContent>
              </DropdownMenuPortal>
            </DropdownMenuSub>
          </DropdownMenuGroup>
          <DropdownMenuSeparator />
          <DropdownMenuGroup>
            <DropdownMenuItem>
              <Icon name="help-circle" />
              Help & Support
            </DropdownMenuItem>
            <DropdownMenuItem>
              <Icon name="file-text" />
              Documentation
            </DropdownMenuItem>
          </DropdownMenuGroup>
          <DropdownMenuSeparator />
          <DropdownMenuGroup>
            <DropdownMenuItem variant="error">
              <Icon name="log-out" />
              Sign Out
              <DropdownMenuShortcut hotkey="Shift+Mod+Q" />
            </DropdownMenuItem>
          </DropdownMenuGroup>
        </DropdownMenuList>
      </DropdownMenuContent>
    </DropdownMenu>
  );
};

import { Button } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/button";
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuGroup,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuLabel,
  DropdownMenuPortal,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuShortcut,
  DropdownMenuSub,
  DropdownMenuSubContent,
  DropdownMenuSubTrigger,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
  DropdownMenuList,
} from "@/registry/erbium/ui/dropdown-menu";

const DropdownMenuDemo = () => (
  <DropdownMenu>
    <DropdownMenuTrigger render={<Button variant="outline">Open</Button>} />
    <DropdownMenuContent className="w-56" align="start">
      <DropdownMenuList>
        <DropdownMenuGroup>
          <DropdownMenuLabel>My Account</DropdownMenuLabel>
          <DropdownMenuItem>
            Profile
            <DropdownMenuShortcut hotkey="Shift+Mod+P" />
          </DropdownMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenuItem>
            Billing
            <DropdownMenuShortcut hotkey="Mod+B" />
          </DropdownMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenuItem>
            Settings
            <DropdownMenuShortcut hotkey="Mod+S" />
          </DropdownMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenuItem>
            Keyboard shortcuts
            <DropdownMenuShortcut hotkey="Mod+K" />
          </DropdownMenuItem>
        </DropdownMenuGroup>
        <DropdownMenuSeparator />
        <DropdownMenuGroup>
          <DropdownMenuItem>Team</DropdownMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenuSub>
            <DropdownMenuSubTrigger>Invite users</DropdownMenuSubTrigger>
            <DropdownMenuPortal>
              <DropdownMenuSubContent>
                <DropdownMenuList>
                  <DropdownMenuItem>Email</DropdownMenuItem>
                  <DropdownMenuItem>Message</DropdownMenuItem>
                  <DropdownMenuSeparator />
                  <DropdownMenuItem>More...</DropdownMenuItem>
                </DropdownMenuList>
              </DropdownMenuSubContent>
            </DropdownMenuPortal>
          </DropdownMenuSub>
          <DropdownMenuItem>
            New Team
            <DropdownMenuShortcut hotkey="Mod+PlusT" />
          </DropdownMenuItem>
        </DropdownMenuGroup>
        <DropdownMenuSeparator />
        <DropdownMenuItem>GitHub</DropdownMenuItem>
        <DropdownMenuItem>Support</DropdownMenuItem>
        <DropdownMenuItem disabled>API</DropdownMenuItem>
        <DropdownMenuSeparator />
        <DropdownMenuItem>
          Log out
          <DropdownMenuShortcut hotkey="Shift+Mod+Q" />
        </DropdownMenuItem>
      </DropdownMenuList>
    </DropdownMenuContent>
  </DropdownMenu>
);

export default DropdownMenuDemo;

          <DropdownMenuItem>
            <Icon name="pencil" />

          <DropdownMenuItem>
            <Icon name="share-01" />

          </DropdownMenuItem>
        </DropdownMenuGroup>
        <DropdownMenuSeparator />

            <Icon name="trash" />

import * as React from "react";
import { Icon } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/icon";

import { Button } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/button";
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuGroup,

  DropdownMenuRadioGroup,
  DropdownMenuRadioItem,

  DropdownMenuList,
} from "@/registry/erbium/ui/dropdown-menu";

export const DropdownMenuRadioIcons = () => {
  const [paymentMethod, setPaymentMethod] = React.useState("card");

  return (
    <DropdownMenu>
      <DropdownMenuTrigger render={<Button variant="outline" />}>
        Payment Method
      </DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <DropdownMenuContent className="min-w-56">
        <DropdownMenuList>
          <DropdownMenuGroup>
            <DropdownMenuLabel>Select Payment Method</DropdownMenuLabel>
            <DropdownMenuRadioGroup value={paymentMethod} onValueChange={setPaymentMethod}>
              <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="card">
                <Icon name="credit-card" />
                Credit Card
              </DropdownMenuRadioItem>
              <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="paypal">
                <Icon name="wallet-01" />
                PayPal
              </DropdownMenuRadioItem>
              <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="bank">
                <Icon name="building-02" />
                Bank Transfer
              </DropdownMenuRadioItem>
            </DropdownMenuRadioGroup>
          </DropdownMenuGroup>
        </DropdownMenuList>
      </DropdownMenuContent>
    </DropdownMenu>
  );
};
